scripts.build: tsc --project tsconfig.json && cp package.json pnpm-lock.yaml pnpm-workspace.yaml ./dist
scripts.smoke-test: node -e "const { VERSION } = require('./dist/index.js'); if (!VERSION || VERSION === 'unknown') throw new Error('Invalid version'); console.log('Smoke test passed. Version:', VERSION);"
scripts.test:all: jest && npm run build && npm run smoke-test
